definition: The daily hour CME Globex stops trading, 16:00 to 17:00 Chicago time Monday to Thursday, and the Sunday 17:00 open.
boundaries: Read from the instrument record's calendar_ref: the calendars cme-equity@1, cme-metals@1, cme-energy@1, cme-fx@1, cme-rates@1 and cme-crypto@1 hold the hours, so the entry holds no second copy. Prices across the break are a gap.
recognition: No orders fill in the break; a stop sits until 17:00.

sources.quote: with a 60-minute break each day beginning at 4:00 p.m.
